## Security verdict: PASS

PR #211, final round 2, at **55431a459d5956fac5933dfab090dd43d63607f2**. Reviewed only the delta from `04865ac60bebcef0a391ccf00521bf6e0fa22c1f`, under C33/C34.

The only changed file is `skills/pij/references/routes/community.md`. Both `directory add` examples at lines 19-20 now use concrete `--kind specialist --lifecycle long-lived --holders one` arguments. Line 30 separately lists the accepted alternatives and explains that `--from file:` supplies only the packet.

The values match help at `crates/core/src/directory.rs:114-116` and the field parser at `crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs:485-490`. File-brief semantics match core help at line 111, the assignment to `fields.brief` at daemon `http/directory.rs:679`, and standing-packet construction at `community/role.rs:207-217`.

**The prior nonblocking clarity note is closed.** No new security vulnerabilities were identified. The earlier review of unchanged material remains applicable; SKILL.md:42 and horse row 9/F169 remain excluded.
